slides.h: What if your skincare could do more?

body: Its outer layer is a protective barrier. It keeps unwanted things out, which is exactly its job.
The catch is that it can also make it harder for some skincare ingredients to get where they’re meant to go.
Glassifier™ uses tiny sponge-derived spicules to create temporary pathways in the skin’s outer layer.
So selected active ingredients, including GHK peptides, can be delivered more effectively than by surface application alone.

slides.h: Skin quality you can see and feel.
